title: mail-server: wire metadata-04 helpers into MemoryBackend
description:
Canonical template. Wire draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-04 into jmap-mail-server MemoryBackend using the jmap-metadata-server baseline (JMAP-5kpy); see the JMAP-s4kp epic for the per-point API recipe.

**1. query_objects filter matching (§3.6):** strip and decode the six metadata* fields from each leaf with `MetadataCondition::take_from` before the typed Email/Mailbox/etc. filter decode; reject per `MetadataFilterError`; AND `matches` with the type's own result. Types not listed in the capability's dataTypes keep rejecting the keys.

**2. get_changes (§3, §3.3):** derive `MetadataOnlyChanges::from_request`. Extend ChangeEntry to record per-updated-id changed properties (`changed_properties(before, after)` in update_object; None when unknown). Fold the window into `ChangedProperties`, drop metadata-only ids under Ignore without counting them toward maxChanges, and emit `updatedProperties` via `updated_properties` (Mailbox passes totalEmails/unreadEmails/totalThreads/unreadThreads).

**3. /set (§2.1, §2.1.1, §3.2):** in create/update, call `check_metadata_write` before applying and `check_metadata_depth` after applying (before storing); map to invalidProperties with `property()`. Normalise an update's `metadata: null` to {} (§3.2). Rule 1 (§4: notFound before forbidden) and the -04 §4.1 container rule remain server-side (see epic notes).
notes:
DECISION Mark 2026-10-22: implement (wire metadata-04 into this MemoryBackend; mail first), using the reusable stub in jmap-metadata-server (JMAP-5kpy). Mark's words: 'implement it, and also stub it and bead it into the helper crate'.
DECISION Mark 2026-10-23: option (A) typed plumbing. Picks: (i) Email and Mailbox only at first; (ii) MemoryBackend supportsPrivate=false (CallerCtx is (), no viewer to own privateMetadata); (iii) opt-in via with_metadata_info, not advertised by default, existing behaviour/tests unchanged; (iv) -04 §4 rule lands here: notFound before forbidden, and maySetMetadata on every container before and after a container change, in update_object using Mailbox.maySetMetadata. Foundation beads: JMAP-cbhv (jmap-server), JMAP-xdp4 (jmap-mail-types) must land first.
